# Let's try clicking red multiple times to see if the level completes
# First, let me batch 5 red clicks and check after each

# Save initial state for comparison
initial_colors = {}
for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] >= 16 and n['pixels'] <= 40 and n['color'] not in ['N', 'G', 'c', 'B']:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
        center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
        initial_colors[(center_r, center_c)] = n['color']

print("Initial state colors:")
for k, v in sorted(initial_colors.items()):
    print(f"  {k} -> {v}")

# Click red 5 times
for i in range(5):
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 32, 'col': 5}])
    done = result.get('level_completed') or result.get('done') or result.get('game_over')
    print(f"\nAfter click {i+1}: done={done}")
    if done:
        print("LEVEL COMPLETE!")
        break
    
    # Check current state
    colors = {}
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] >= 16 and n['pixels'] <= 40 and n['color'] not in ['N', 'G', 'c', 'B']:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
            center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
            colors[(center_r, center_c)] = n['color']
    
    # Print top row and left/right columns
    top = [colors.get((20, c), '?') for c in [13, 19, 25, 31, 37, 43, 49]]
    left = [colors.get((r, 13), '?') for r in [26, 32, 38, 44]]
    right = [colors.get((r, 49), '?') for r in [26, 32, 38, 44]]
    bottom = [colors.get((44, c), '?') for c in [13, 19, 25, 31, 37, 43, 49]]
    print(f"  Top: {top}")
    print(f"  Left: {left}, Right: {right}")
    print(f"  Bottom: {bottom}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
